summary: Complete implementation plan for 'FREE DOWNLOAD' - an ad-free Android video downloader and offline player application featuring multi-platform link parsing, resolution/quality picker (1080p, 720p, 480p, 360p, Audio), high-speed download engine with real-time transfer telemetry, Room-persisted download manager, and gesture-driven Media3 ExoPlayer with PiP and speed controls in a cyberpunk-inspired dark aesthetic.
